findings.title: The refusal table does not cover the new "moving" reason
findings.body: `relocate-copy.ts:35-36` adds `case "moving"` → `relocateMoving`, and `shared/types/workspaces.ts:158` adds the reason, but the "explains each remaining refusal" table (lines 323-331) lists `recording` and `exporting` and has no `moving` row. If the case or the key were dropped, it would fall into the `relocateFailed` default and no test would notice. Add `[{ ok: false, reason: "moving" }, /Wait for the move/]`.

findings.title: Docs say Change folder… is refused only while a recording or export runs
findings.body: This PR makes a group move refuse a relocate too (`main/workspaces/index.ts:347` passes `busy: busyNow`, which returns `"moving"` while `moveRun` is set; `relocate.ts:24-25` returns that reason). This banner and the `workspaces:relocate` row in the spec (2026-10-29-several-workspaces-design.md, "while a recording or export runs") still list only the other two. Add "or a move" to both.

contracts.action: Change folder… (workspaces:relocate) is now refused with reason "moving" while a group move runs
contracts.equivalent_path: The existing recording/exporting refusal in relocateRefusal, which reads deps.busy() both before the folder picker opens (index.ts:483) and again in relocateWorkspace (relocate.ts:33) after a folder is picked.
contracts.before_after: Before, busy was supplied only in the switch deps, so relocate had no "moving" signal. Now activeTransactionDeps() carries busy: busyNow, so switch, relocate and relocateActive share one lock: host.busy() when recording or exporting, otherwise "moving" while moveRun is set (index.ts:66-68). The check runs before the picker and again after it, so a move that starts while the picker is open is still caught.
contracts.visible_effect: relocateFolder returns { ok:false, reason:"moving" } to the renderer, and relocateRefusalMessage maps it to relocateMoving (relocate-copy.ts:35-36), present in en.json and es.json. The dialog shows it as an alert.
contracts.failure_mode: The reason is in WorkspaceRelocateRefusal (shared/types/workspaces.ts:158), so the renderer switch has a branch for it and nothing falls to relocateFailed. A relocate that races a move start is blocked by the second busyNow check. Nothing is lost.

thread_replies.reply: Confirmed. `chipLabel`, `newWorkspace` and `reason_stale` in es.json now say "espacio de trabajo" (lines 2639, 2645, 2685).

structuredOutput.summary: The relocate "moving" lock holds as intended. `busyNow` is now in the shared transaction deps, so relocate is refused both before the picker opens and again after a folder is picked. The renderer maps the new reason to a message that exists in en and es. The remaining findings are small: the dialog test table has no `moving` row, and the relocate docs still list only recording and export as refusals. The earlier es.json thread on "workspace" wording is addressed.
